author: pritampalit
body:
#### TensorFlow (TF) -to-ONNX Migration of CMS DeepTau Models for Efficient Inference in CMSSW and SONIC

The DeepTau models are migrated from TensorFlow to ONNX within CMSSW using ONNX Runtime. In parallel, the
TF-based deployment in SONIC has been replaced with ONNX models served through Triton. The CMSSW migration
covers DeepTau v2.1, DeepTau v2.5, boosted DeepTau and Phase 2 DeepTau models in Run 3, DeepTau v2.5 along with the latest boosted DeepTau model.

Details can be found in this DP note : https://cmsfence.cern.ch/alcm/note/details/20647

This PR includes corresponding cms-data PR : https://github.com/cms-data/RecoTauTag-TrainingFiles/pull/17
title: TFtoONNX migration of DeepTau models in CMSSW and SONIC
